name: Wandering Relics
source: Mina Drumarsstad, 1935. A city of Art Deco shadows where butterfly entities hold power over fate. You arrive as a stranger — but the city already knows your name. Three beings. Three natures: Enigma, Alpha, Omega. One choice that changes everything.
